data.one_liner: Generates dependency injection code using the kiwi package.
data.what_it_does: Generates implementation code for abstract injector classes using annotations like @Register.factory and @Register.singleton. It integrates with build_runner to automate kiwi container registrations and reduce boilerplate.
use_when: You are using the kiwi package for dependency injection and want to automate container setup
You prefer annotation-based dependency injection generation using build_runner
avoid_when: You prefer manual dependency registration without code generation
You are using a different dependency injection framework like get_it or injectable
strengths: Reduces manual boilerplate code for kiwi container registrations
Supports named factories, custom constructors, and type resolution mapping via annotations
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner for code generation
Tied strictly to the kiwi dependency injection package ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Add build_runner and kiwi_generator to dev_dependencies, kiwi to dependencies, and run build_runner to generate code.

alternatives.name: injectable_generator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative code-generation-based dependency injection tool typically used with get_it.

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: Service locator pattern without mandatory code generation.
